relationships.subject: glycated collagen matrix
relationships.evidence_quote: we showed that ECM-GC increased c-Fos expression in human sensory-like neurons

key_findings: Glycated collagen matrix activates SH-SY5Y-derived human sensory-like neurons, raising c-Fos, SCN9A, TACR1 and substance P release.
Morphine reduces glycated-matrix-induced substance P release, supporting the model for analgesic screening.
